settings.heading: HICH Gallery
settings.text: HICH Gallery began with a word — هیچ, hich — which means “nothing” in Farsi. Founded in Chicago by Bety Shahlaei, Fozhan Bozorgi and Rojin Bozorgi: three women bound by family.

settings.name: Betsabeh Shahlaei
settings.bio: Contemporary international visual artist working in Persian calligraphy, Khattashi, Tazhib, acrylic and mixed media.
